faq_heading: Burnaby Lake houses: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Burnaby Lake. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Burnaby Lake, Burnaby: 21 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 2 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 10%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 7 of 35 Burnaby communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Burnaby Lake fell from 24 in June to 21 in October (−12.5%), and 8 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 4.9% of Burnaby’s 430 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Burnaby Lake?
Burnaby Lake also had 3 condos and townhomes listed and 0 sold in October, against 21 houses listed. The Burnaby Lake condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Burnaby Lake home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

16 houses sold in Burnaby Lake with a median price of $1,825,000 (the middle half sold between $1,517,950 and $2,188,500), taking a median of 29 days to sell at 93.8% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $620 per square foot, a median year built of 1975 and a median lot of 8,000 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Burnaby Lake?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 21 houses listed in Burnaby Lake. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Burnaby Lake a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Burnaby Lake had a sales ratio of 10%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Burnaby Lake from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 8 houses sold in Burnaby Lake over those 5 months, out of 251 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Burnaby Lake?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Burnaby Lake sell for?
faq.a: 16 houses sold in Burnaby Lake between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,825,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Burnaby Lake?
faq.a: The median was 29 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 93.8% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
